title: A bar pressed past yield
model: a 10 x 10 x 40 mm steel bar on rollers at x = 0, y = 0 and z = 0, 300 MPa on its top; the library's steel curve, linear hardening at E/100 (H = E/99 in plastic strain) from f_y 250 MPa; 5 mm elements, 6 increments

plastic_strain.source: linear isotropic hardening under uniaxial stress: eps_p = (sigma - f_y) / H, H = E/99 (EN 1993-1-5:2006 Annex C.6(2), the library's curve)
plastic_strain.reason: the stress is uniform, so the element holds it exactly; what is left is CalculiX's increments, each converged to its residual, and the plastic strain carried from its integration points to the nodes
